theme: Warm Swiss utility: light-first, with optional deep ink mode
success_actions: Understand review status and missing documents
Move an applicant to the next stage
Create an applicant or assign a follow-up
emotional_tone: Calm authority, human attention, operational confidence

design_concepts.name: The Registrar Desk
design_concepts.direction: Warm bone surfaces, ink typography, red used only for urgent actions; dense but generous dashboard hierarchy.

design_concepts.name: Field Notes
design_concepts.direction: Sage and clay accents, evidence-led applicant profiles, document checklist as a visual field log.

design_concepts.name: Decision Room
design_concepts.direction: Ink navy, wine, and parchment; review stages feel deliberate and consequential without feeling intimidating.

design_concepts.name: Signal / Queue
design_concepts.direction: Off-white base with signal red and warning yellow only for state; status and next action are instantly scannable.

design_concepts.name: Soft Proof
design_concepts.direction: Pale butter, mint, and peach with hard ink rules; approachable for new reviewers while retaining credibility.

typography.headings: Work Sans, 700/850; use tight tracking and sentence-case headings
typography.body: IBM Plex Sans, 400/500; relaxed line height
typography.data_and_labels: IBM Plex Mono, 500; uppercase labels with tracking-[0.18em]
rules: Do not use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Lato, or Space Grotesk for headings
H1 maximum text-6xl; H2 maximum text-4xl
Keep labels tiny but never below 12px equivalent
Left-align operational content; reserve centered alignment for empty states

colors.archetype: Swiss & high-contrast with warm paper tint
rules: Use red only for urgent/negative states and primary CTA
Meet 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text/actions
No full-screen gradients; use solid tinted surfaces and grain

layouts.app_shell: Desktop: fixed left rail 248px, content column, optional right context drawer. Mobile: top bar plus bottom tab bar.
layouts.dashboard: High-density 1/3/4-column grid: KPI spans 1, funnel/chart spans 2, alerts/feed spans 1 row-span-2. Use direct grid children and h-full.
layouts.applications: List + detail split view. Filters stay above the list; selected applicant opens a detail panel without losing queue position.
layouts.profile: Applicant identity and next action at top; timeline and review rubric in the main column; documents and alerts in a narrow side column.
layouts.spacing: Use 2-3x normal spacing: section padding 24-48px, panel padding 24px, grid gaps 16-24px. Never let bordered content touch its edge.

grids.application_queue: Use a 12-column desktop composition: applicant identity 4, program 2, stage 2, score 1, deadline 2, action 1.
grids.visual_rule: Expose the skeleton with 1px tinted rules; avoid equal-square bento repetition.

component_path: Use existing frontend/app and shared components; for JavaScript implementation use .js files and React Native StyleSheet conventions. If a web shell is added, keep reusable UI in frontend/src/components/.

motion.entrance: Stagger queue rows by 35ms with opacity and translateY
motion.interaction: Use 160-220ms transitions for button opacity, backgroundColor, borderColor and transform only where intentional
motion.workflow: Stage changes animate the active rule and announce status text; do not rely on color alone
motion.loading: Use skeleton rows and a subtle progress shimmer, not spinners everywhere
motion.reduced_motion: Disable stagger, shimmer, parallax, and decorative motion when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled

visual_enhancers: Subtle paper grain overlay at 3-5% opacity
Use glass only for sticky header with opaque white/70 plus blur and inner border

media.instruction: This is an operations app; prioritize applicant document thumbnails only when real data exists. Do not use placeholder image URLs or decorative stock photography.

3d libraries.reason: Clarity and scanability matter more than immersion for admissions operations.

accessibility: Every button, link, input, menu, tab, metric, alert, applicant row, and confirmation must include data-testid in kebab-case
Provide visible focus states with 2px high-contrast outline
Use accessible labels and announcements for stage/status changes
Status chips require text plus icon or shape, never color alone
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds behind readable content
Ensure charts have labels, a table/list alternative, and color-blind-safe hues
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: Avoid generic centered layouts and uniform cards
Use asymmetric hierarchy and intentional negative space
Prefer flat rectangular surfaces with subtle borders; radius max 8px for dashboard panels
Primary color is reserved for primary CTA and active workflow state
Never use AI assistant emoji characters as icons
Use lucide or existing icon library, with aria-hidden on decorative icons
Use Sonner for toast feedback if web components are introduced
All key informational elements must have stable data-testid attributes
Validate all real API flows; clearly mark any mocked data or mocked integration in the UI
implementation_notes_for_main_agent: The supplied repository is Expo/React Native with .tsx entry files, while the requested handoff convention references .js. Preserve the repository's working file format unless converting is intentional; apply these rules equally to JavaScript components.
Replace the placeholder image screen with the admissions shell and functional local state first.
Connect dashboard metrics, recent applications, alerts, search/filter, checklist updates, review-stage changes, and quick actions to FastAPI endpoints.
Keep backend data models explicit for applicants, applications, documents, review events, alerts, and metrics.
Do not claim persistence works until the API and database path are verified; mark unconnected flows as MOCKED.
